summary:
WP-B is done on branch wp-b (head fb00d93). The build passes, the smoke test passes 6/6 and there are no console errors. What landed:
- The full §7.2 CameraFeeds API: VMD alerts with ack, alert levels, the blind-spot stage guard, frozen time, clockStamp/minuteK seconds, the OSD tag and alarm line, AGC × meanScale, sub-pose plumbing, the REC-dot fade, and clearing on reset and on mode change.
- Amber CAM-button LEDs and setBlastLocked with the new lamp states in ControlRoom.
- The vmdTone and doorKnock sounds, calibrated quiet.
- The scripts/pacing-run.mjs browser harness.

Everything was seen working in 960x540 screenshots and measured:
- **LED:** breathes with 14.4% undulation on a 2.4 s period, and stays steady under reduceFlicker.
- **Sounds:** at the seat, at volume 1.0, peaks are −30.8 dBFS (vmdTone) and −29.7 to −31.0 dBFS (doorKnock), against the −28 cap.
- **Channel switch with a darkened stage:** brightness changes at most 11.5% per 0.25 s with the meanScale compensation, against 22.7% without it.
- **Blast-door lock:** the sequence was shot frame by frame, and the ending still opens the door from the locked state.

Two deviations from the spec text, both made for comfort and audibility:
- **LED breathing depth:** the spec's 0.3–1.0 range was cut to 0.85–1.0 so it stays within the ≤15% rule.
- **Sound gains:** the spec's starting gains measured −45 / −42 dBFS, which is inaudible under the ambience (about −37 dBFS RMS), so I raised them to sit just under the cap.
done: CameraFeeds §7.2: get shownChannel; raiseAlert(n,{stamp}) → stamp (LD only; refreshes the stamp if already alerted; emits feeds:alert {channel, stamp}); alerts (n → {stamp, t0, obs}); isAlerted; alertLevel (damped, λ=4); clearAlerts
Ack inside update() right after _blindSpot: CAM-0n shown and observed for 1.0 s → alert deleted and feeds:alertAck {channel} emitted (verified: ack at +1.1 s after switch-in)

setAnomalyStage(n,k,{force}) with the hard blind-spot guard (n≠3: refuses when channel or shownChannel is n; n=3: refuses when shown and mainScreenObserved; throttled console.warn), calls ch.setStage?.(k) with feature detection, sets _needRender when shown; anomalyStage(n) (verified: shown CAM-04 → false, CAM-02 → true, force → true)
setFrozenTime(n,text|null): the OSD time shows the frozen text, recOff is set, and the REC dot fades via a per-channel _recK on uRec.w (verified: 02:14:08, uRec.w = 0)
clockStamp() and _timestamp: use floor(60·flags.minuteK) when it is finite, with a stale-k guard on minute flips so seconds never run backwards; otherwise today's formula

OSD: tag '▲ 動態偵測 HH:MM:SS' under the CAM id; alarm line '▲ CAM-0n…' under the timestamp (alerted channels other than the shown one, ascending); recOff; all included in the redraw key. Text comes from SCRIPT.feedUI with the spec text as fallback
Tag latch: set in _beginSwitch for the alerted channel and kept for the whole visit; follows a shown-but-unobserved channel (CAM-03 while the player is at a wall; verified)
AGC × meanScale: _beginSwitch uses FEED_LUM·ms(n) for both sides and _meanOf('LD') uses FEED_MEAN·ms(n), where ms = channels[n].meanScale ?? 1

Sub-pose branch in _blindSpot (LD, subPoses, unobserved ≥ 0.5 s, seenSinceMove, index ≥ limits.max, !figureSub, index ≤ 5) emits feeds:figureMoved {index, sub:true}. figureSub resets on every step and on setFigureIndex. _applyFigure passes figureSub and tracks _shownSub. Logic verified: one sub-pose per index, none when subPoses is false

reset(): all setStage(0), clearAlerts, frozen times cleared, figureSub=false, tag cleared, LED levels and REC fade snapped. _beginMode(m !== 'LD') clears alerts, tag and frozen times. createChannels(ctx.SCRIPT)

ControlRoom CAM LEDs: green·sel·(1−al) + amber·al·breath; breath 0.85–1.0 cosine with a 2.4 s period; steady 0.8 under reduceFlicker; glow 0.35 → 0.45 with alert level; LED colour only, no lights added

ControlRoom.setBlastLocked(locked,{duration=2.4}) → Promise: wheel ±2.5π over 0.7·duration, then bolts over 0.3·duration; duration ≤ 0 snaps; states locking/unlocking → locked/unlocked; blastLocked getter. Lamp: unlocked green 0.7; locking/unlocking amber 1.4 s breathing at ≤15% (steady 0.6 under reduceFlicker); 'opening' now also honours reduceFlicker; lamp colour lerp exp(−5·dt), so ramps take ≥ 0.4 s

sfx.vmdTone (relay click plus 1046→784 Hz pips, low-passed at 2.4 kHz) and sfx.doorKnock(count, amp) (low-pass 520 Hz, door IR, first knock at 0.7×); SFX_GAIN vmdTone 0.5 and doorKnock 0.24; AudioEngine header documents both

Measured peaks, post-limiter, seated, volume 1.0: vmdTone −30.8 dBFS; doorKnock with 3 knocks −29.7 to −31.0; with 2 knocks at amp 0.8, −31.7 to −32.4 (cap −28). For reference: button −25, camSwitch −24, doorThud −33, ambience about −37.5 dBFS RMS

LED measured over time: material luminance 0.825–0.964 (14.4% undulation, 2.4 s period, ≤ 3.9% change per 0.25 s); steady 0.779 for more than 4 s under reduceFlicker; amber → green cross-fade after ack takes about 0.8 s
Switch luminance with an emulated darkened CAM-01 stage (exposure × 0.78, meanScale 0.78): ≤ 11.5% change per 0.25 s with no reversals; without the meanScale term it is 22.7%
Blast-door lock sequence shots (green unlocked → amber locking → red locked, bolts visibly extend); openBlastDoor still works from the locked state (door slides fully open, bolts retract)

scripts/pacing-run.mjs (§9.2): Playwright autopilot (personas eager/typical/starer/passive, same parameters as pace-proto); handles the lock, intercom and vent gates and the CAM-03 alarm; aborts if the player is seated but the screen is not observed. An in-page recorder works independently of the director (bus events, flag rising edges, flips) and merges __paceLog and [pace] console lines. It wraps setStage to catch stage changes on a displayed channel, prints a per-minute table, applies the spec's assertions (exit 1, or --no-assert), and writes a JSON file. Verified end-to-end on today's flow: act 295.6 s, 0 errors

apiNotes:
CameraFeeds (§7.2 implemented exactly):
- `alerts` is a plain object keyed by number. `raiseAlert` returns null and does nothing outside LD; the default stamp is `clockStamp()`. It re-emits `feeds:alert` when it refreshes an existing alert, so count unique alerts if you need a tally.
- Ack needs `_shownMode === 'LD'`, `_shownChannel === n` and `isChannelObserved(n)` held continuously for `ACK_TIME` = 1.0 s.
- `feeds:figureMoved` now always carries `sub` (false for normal steps).
- The sub-pose cap is a local `SUBPOSE_MAX = 5`, not imported from Figure.js: a namespace import of a missing export makes esbuild warn before WP-A lands. Sub-poses run only in LD and are on by default. WP-C sets `feeds.subPoses = false` for `?subposes=0` / `?pace=0`.
- `setAnomalyStage`:
  - without `ch.setStage` (pre-WP-A) it stores the requested stage in `_stageFallback` and returns true;
  - `anomalyStage` reads `ch.stage` first;
  - a guard refusal warns once per 2 s game time.
- `setFrozenTime(n, null | '')` unfreezes. The REC dot fades per channel (`_recK`, λ=5), so a channel frozen off-screen has no dot by the time it is switched in.
- `_timestamp` ignores a stale `minuteK` (≥ 0.5) right after `clockText` changes and shows :00 until the director resets k.
- Tag and alarm text come from `SCRIPT.feedUI.motionTag` / `alarmLine`, with identical fallbacks in CameraFeeds.

ControlRoom:
- `setBlastLocked(locked, {duration = 2.4})` → Promise and `get blastLocked` (true only when the state is 'locked').
- Snapping with duration ≤ 0 also closes the door.
- The bolts start moving at 0.7·duration (= +1.68 s), which is when the unlatch and pneumaticHiss sfx should play.
- `reset()` still leaves the door locked; `resetWorld` must call `setBlastLocked(false, {duration: 0})`.
- Tunable constants:
  - `CAM_LED {period: 2.4, depth: 0.15, steady: 0.8, glow: 0.45}`;
  - `BLAST_LAMP {period: 1.4, depth: 0.15, level: 0.7, steady: 0.6, unlocked: 0.7, lerp: 5}`.

Spec deviations:
- **LED breathing:** the amber LED breathes between 0.85 and 1.0, not the spec's 0.3–1.0, to meet the ≤15% undulation rule. If the owner wants a stronger pulse, set `CAM_LED.depth` to 0.7.
- **Lamp lerp:** the lamp colour lerp is now exp(−5·dt) instead of −8, so changes take ≥ 0.4 s. This also applies to the ending's 'opening' transitions, and 'opening' now holds steady at 0.6 under reduceFlicker.
- **Sound gains:** `SFX_GAIN.vmdTone` is 0.5 and `doorKnock` is 0.24. The spec's starting values (0.10 / 0.06) measured −44.8 / −42.3 dBFS, well under the ambience.

Audio:
- `audio.sfx('vmdTone', {position})`: the position should be the CAM button's world position (`points.camButtons[n-1]`, which WP-C adds).
- `audio.sfx('doorKnock', {position: points.blastDoor, count, amp})`; returns duration 2.2.

Harness:
- `node scripts/pacing-run.mjs [--html dist/blind-spot.html] [--speed 3] [--persona typical|eager|starer|passive] [--runs 3] [--seed 1] [--size 960x540] [--query 'lock=0'] [--timeout-min 9] [--out test-output/pacing] [--no-assert] [--logs]`.
- It relies on WP-C setting `flags.lockPending`, `blastLocked`, `blastLocking` and `doorKnocked`, and on the bus event 'blastDoor:lock'. Intercom and vent go through `BS.interact.trigger('intercom' / 'vent')`.
- Gaps are computed from the harness's own recorder, so they do not depend on what the director's trace contains.
- On the loaded machine use `--size 480x270 --speed 4` (about 4–8 minutes per run).

No files outside WP-B ownership were touched.
docNotes:
ARCHITECTURE:
- **§5 events:** add `feeds:alert {channel, stamp}` (CameraFeeds.raiseAlert), `feeds:alertAck {channel}` (CameraFeeds, after 1.0 s observed), and change `feeds:figureMoved` to `{index, sub}` (sub = capped-window sub-pose).
- **Module contracts:**
  - CameraFeeds adds shownChannel, raiseAlert / alerts / isAlerted / alertLevel / clearAlerts, setAnomalyStage (blind-spot guard) / anomalyStage, setFrozenTime, clockStamp, and subPoses / figureSub.
  - The OSD shows the motion tag (under the CAM id) and the alarm line (under the timestamp).
  - The AGC multiplies by `channels[n].meanScale`.
  - ControlRoom adds setBlastLocked(locked, {duration}) → Promise and blastLocked; door-lamp colours: unlocked green, locking/unlocking amber with slow ≤15% breathing, locked red.
- **AudioEngine sfx list:** add vmdTone and doorKnock; both measured ≤ −28 dBFS at the seat (−30.8 and about −30.5 dBFS at volume 1.0).
- **§9 tests:** add `scripts/pacing-run.mjs` (the browser timing harness, §9.2).

DESIGN-NOTES A5:
- The VMD cue language is: a CAM-button LED that cross-fades to amber and breathes ≤ 15% over 2.4 s (steady under reduceFlicker), a soft tone, the OSD tag and alarm line, a SYS LOG line, and the prompt suffix.
- The hard guard in CameraFeeds.setAnomalyStage enforces blind-spot purity even if the director misbehaves.
- Switching into a darkened stage keeps the ≤30%-per-0.25 s rule through AGC × meanScale (measured 11.5% with an emulated 0.78 stage).
- A frozen OSD time fades its REC dot per channel, off-screen.
- Sub-poses happen once per index, LD only, and never at index 6 or 7.
testsRun:
Build:
- `node scripts/build.mjs --out /tmp/impl-wp-b/check.html` passes at every commit.
- `node scripts/smoke-test.mjs` on dist: 6/6 PASS, no console errors (dist reverted afterwards).

Browser probes (Playwright + SwiftShader; scripts in /tmp/impl-wp-b/):
1. `t_alert.js` (960x540): alert, LED, OSD, ack, guard, frozen time and the CAM-03 tag. Evidence in /tmp/impl-wp-b/ev/:
   - seated views: seated_alert.png, seated_alert_buttons_x2.png (amber LEDs on CAM-01 and CAM-04, green on CAM-03), seated_alert_crt_x2.png, seated_cam4_tag.png, seated_cam4_crt_x2.png;
   - CRT close-ups via debugBlit: crt_cam3_alarm.png ('▲ CAM-01 CAM-04'), crt_cam4_tag.png ('▲ 動態偵測 01:58:41'), crt_cam4_frozen.png (02:14:08, no REC dot), crt_cam3_tag_unobserved.png, crt_cam3_after.png;
   - results: ack 1.1 s after switch-in; guard results {shown4: false, other2: true, force4: true}; 0 errors.
2. `t_led.js` (640x360, speed 2): /tmp/impl-wp-b/t_led.out, /tmp/impl-wp-b/ev/led_samples.json, led_seated_breathing.png.
   - Breathing: material luminance 0.8254–0.9641, undulation 14.4%, periods 2.4 / 2.4 s, at most 3.9% change per 0.25 s.
   - reduceFlicker: constant 0.7792.
   - Fade-in and the ack cross-fade take about 0.6–0.8 s.
   - The pixel ROI is noise-limited by film grain: its noise floor is 11% even when the LED is steady.
3. `t_audio.js` (needs a local HTTP server for the AudioWorklet meter on BS.audio.trim; started and stopped): /tmp/impl-wp-b/ev/audio_peaks_vol1.txt.
   - vmdTone −30.8 dBFS ×10 runs.
   - doorKnock (3 knocks, amp 1) −29.7 to −31.0 dBFS.
   - doorKnock (2 knocks, amp 0.8) −31.7 to −32.4 dBFS.
   - Ambience −37.5 dBFS RMS.
4. `t_door.js` (960x540): /tmp/impl-wp-b/ev/door_sheet.png (door_0…door_5) and door_bolts_compare.png; lamp and bolt samples in /tmp/impl-wp-b/t_door.out and ev/door_samples.json.
   - The lock finishes at +2.6 s with blastLocked true.
   - Amber breathing during the lock: 0.60–0.68 (≤ 12%).
   - openBlastDoor from the locked state reaches door 1.85 = slide.
5. `t_sub.js`: /tmp/impl-wp-b/t_sub.out. Sub-pose fired once at index 0, did not repeat, the next step reset figureSub, and a sub-pose then fired at index 1.
6. `t_agc.js` (480x270): /tmp/impl-wp-b/t_agc.out. With meanScale 0.78 the CRT changes at most 11.2% (3→1) and 11.5% (1→3) per 0.25 s; with meanScale 1 it is 14.2% and 22.7%, with reversals.
7. `scripts/pacing-run.mjs --html /tmp/impl-wp-b/game.html --speed 4 --runs 1 --size 480x270 --no-assert` (today's flow, no director): /tmp/impl-wp-b/pacing-run1.out. Act 295.6 s, max gap 42.4 s, figure 7 at blackout, 0 on-screen stage changes, 0 errors; the per-minute table printed correctly.
